subject: [PATCH 5/8] mm/gup: fill the pages array outside the pud/pmd lock

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the huge page handling in the Linux kernel's mm/gup module to fill the pages array and flush caches outside of the pud/pmd lock. The current implementation holds the lock while filling the pages array, which is unnecessary since neither the flush operations nor the page table modifications require exclusive access. By moving the fill operation after unlocking, the patch reduces contention and improves concurrency in the kernel's memory management code.
